response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per), above AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS m FROM above) SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, a.avg_mod - a.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, a.avg_mod / am.m AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above a CROSS JOIN above_mean am ORDER BY ratio_to_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
